title: PlaneMem historical checkpoint content reads
description: Source-only public session checkpoint history and exact checkpoint detail. Saved notes and reference metadata are not an original save receipt or proof referenced ContextPack/memory remains readable or valid. Register session-activity-read.json alongside this resource.
$comment: Closed shapes describe reconstructed server output, not all extensions tolerated by input parsers. Runtime additionally checks exact target/scope/trace, UTF-16 lengths, real dates, source membership/uniqueness, memory JSON depth and complete serialized candidate-envelope byte limits. No validator/generator/client machine-contract integration or execution evidence.

text.$comment: Existing saved-record parser checks <=4096 UTF-16 units, not Unicode scalar count. No extra control/DEL/lone-surrogate restriction; whitespace around nonblank text is retained.

time.$comment: Output normalized by toISOString, including extended years. Input parser accepts any <=128 UTF-16 date string with finite Date.parse, not only canonical UTC input. Pattern alone does not check calendar validity.

notes.description: Complete original array, including empty strings/whitespace/newlines, with order/duplicates preserved. No per-note/item count limit or trimming; bounded only as part of candidate full JSON.

historyQuery.description: Path session plus optional exclusive positive safe numeric revision. Fixed page size10; limit is not accepted. HTTP numeric query digits only, leading zeros allowed. Raw boundary need not identify an existing revision and binds no identity/scope.

memory.description: Full original memory reference including extensions, structured-cloned after JSON depth<=32/finite-number/plain-object checks. Scope equals current request/checkpoint. Hash is nonblank text, not necessarily sha256 and not recomputed. Every memory source type/id must occur in checkpoint sources; memory source duplicates and different revision/URI for same type/id are not independently rejected. No provider call or current validity check.

record.description: Complete saved record with original trace independent of current outer trace. Runtime scope/IDs match request; source type/id pairs unique, contain requested session and bound pack when present. Source extensions survive. state_hash is nonblank<=4096 text, not recomputed; legacy hash without pack ID may be arbitrary nonblank<=4096 text. Optional SQL null pack/memory fields omitted. No current session version/status, original request key or created_at inside this record.

historyEntry.description: Historical note projection, deliberately omits state_hash/memory_ref/source_refs/schema_version/scope. Saved trace and hash-without-ID have no individual4096 length bound here, unlike full detail. Bound pack requires canonical sha256 shape but no digest/source/current validity check. No per-entry context_pack_state field.

historyEnvelope.description: Public GET shape, not workbench history with identity/permission hints. Exact current trace/scope/session. Runtime entries have same session, unique checkpoint IDs and strictly descending safe numeric revisions below incoming bound; continuation equals last revision of a full10 page and is>1. Server checks11th position ID/revision/order and null payload without parsing its notes/date. No total or current session version/identity/ETag. Candidate-envelope UTF-8 JSON.stringify budget8MiB checked before parser date normalization; no independent final wire check in this parser.

detailEnvelope.description: Exact current trace/requested session+checkpoint/scope and sole outer checkpoint source. Scope exists inside checkpoint, not outer envelope. context_pack_state always not-checked even without bound pack. No ETag/identity/permissions/outer revision. Candidate-envelope UTF-8 JSON.stringify budget2MiB checked before date normalization; stored reference/hash presence does not establish validity.
